authorship_scope: Root authored both implementation and this orchestration audit while workers were usage-limited. Mathematical replay uses unchanged independent physical and exact-BR oracle code; no second reviewer author is claimed.

aggregate_preparation.scope: Logical preparation entries only; no Python object size, allocation, runtime or RSS guarantee.

structural_graph_validation.scope: Separately bounded structural scans, reference copies, information indexing and identity validation. Existing named exact node/edge and mass charges remain unchanged. These conservative envelopes can overlap; they are not Python-operation, byte, runtime or RSS totals.

terminal_group_census.scope: Fresh census piggybacked on the shared all-positive BR traversal. Fixed setup/output reservations cover aggregate counts, counter, closure, receipt and preparation mapping slots; per-group setup/frame/reference/output counts are also charged. Logical entries are not bytes, Python allocations, runtime or RSS.
